name: Custom Shape 1-Layer Wooden Clipboard Picture Frame
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from durable 5mm wood for a sturdy and long-lasting frame.
    - Includes a metal photo clip for secure and convenient photo display.
    - Comes with metal rivets, spacers, and washers for stable tabletop placement.
    - Uses 250gsm paper for the interchangeable printed photo.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Frame size: 8 × 8 in ~ 20.32 × 20.32 cm
    - Metal spacer length: 5 cm ~ 1.97 in
    - Metal spacer diameter: 1.2 cm ~ 0.47 in
    - Photo clip size: 7.2 × 3 cm ~ 2.83 × 1.18 in
    - Distance between clip holes: 4 cm ~ 1.57 in
    - Rivets and mounting accessories are included.
    📌 Note: The dimensions of product may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology for vibrant colors and sharp details.
    - Wooden frame features 2-sided printing.
    - The removable photo is printed one-sided on 250gsm paper.
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Displays photos, milestone cards, notes, or meaningful messages.
    - Metal clip allows photos to be inserted, removed, and replaced easily.
    - Freestanding metal spacers provide stable tabletop display.
    - Suitable for desks, shelves, mantels, nightstands, offices, and event tables.
    - Can be used as a baby milestone frame, family photo display, memorial frame, or celebration keepsake.
    - Reusable design allows the displayed photo to be updated for different memories and occasions.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - Perfect for baby births, first Christmas, and monthly milestone celebrations.
    - Great for birthdays, anniversaries, weddings, and graduations.
    - Ideal for Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, Grandparents’ Day, and Christmas.
    - Suitable for housewarmings, memorial keepsakes, retirement gifts, and family celebrations.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1-3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6-9 working days average (US)
  • Packaging:1 x Custom Shape 1-Layer Frosted Acrylic Money Holder

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

 

NOTE:

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 

  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
